texts.li: [started] {A_nameDef} has been in {FIGHTS} this past month, with {WITH}, and threw the first punch at least once. Most of the colony gives {A_objective} a wide berth now, and hardly anyone takes {A_possessive} side.\n\n{B_nameDef}, the colony's {TITLE}, has brought it to the council. Nobody is asking for anything drastic yet, only what the council means to do about it.

[joined] {A_nameDef} has been in {FIGHTS} this past month, with {WITH}. Whoever swung first, most of the colony has stopped taking {A_possessive} side, and hardly anyone sits near {A_objective} at supper.\n\n{B_nameDef}, the colony's {TITLE}, wants the council to decide what to do before the next one.

[insults] Hard words, then fists: {A_nameDef} has been in {FIGHTS} this past month, with {WITH}, and has been throwing insults around besides. Most of the colony can't stand {A_objective} now, and almost nobody stands up for {A_objective}.\n\n{B_nameDef}, the colony's {TITLE}, has asked the council what it means to do.

{A_nameDef} has been in {FIGHTS} this past month, with {WITH}. The rest of the colony has had enough, and almost nobody stands by {A_objective}.\n\n{B_nameDef}, the colony's {TITLE}, has brought it to the council.

li.label: {B_nameDef} has a word with {A_nameDef}, face to face
li.outcome: The council asked {B_nameDef} to have a word with {A_nameDef} about the fights, face to face, and it will remember that it did.

li.label: Keep {A_nameDef} to the night hours for a while
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} works the nights for the next few days and sleeps while the others are up, on the council's word.

li.label: Let it be
li.outcome: The council let it be. {A_nameDef} carries on as before, and so, for now, does everyone else.

texts.li: [warned] The council's word didn't settle it. Since then {A_nameDef} has been in {FIGHTS} more, with {WITH}, and some at the table now say the colony would be better off without {A_objective}.\n\n{VOICES}

[warned,started] After the council's word, {A_nameDef} has thrown punches again: {FIGHTS} since, with {WITH}. {B_nameDef}, the colony's {TITLE}, has put the question to the council plainly: how much longer?\n\n{VOICES}

[apart] The nights apart didn't settle it. Since then {A_nameDef} has been in {FIGHTS} more, with {WITH}, and some at the table now say the colony would be better off without {A_objective}.\n\n{VOICES}
{A_nameDef} is in trouble again: {FIGHTS} since the council last stepped in, with {WITH}. {B_nameDef}, the colony's {TITLE}, has put it to the council once more.\n\n{VOICES}

[apart,insults] Kept to the nights for a while, {A_nameDef} found trouble anyway: {FIGHTS} since, with {WITH}, and hard words besides. {B_nameDef}, the colony's {TITLE}, wants the council to decide, once and for all.\n\n{VOICES}

li.label: {BANISH}
li.outcome: The council has decided: {A_nameDef} is to be {WORD}. {B_nameDef} will tell {A_objective} face to face.

li.label: A last word from {B_nameDef}
li.outcome: The council gave {A_nameDef} one last chance, and asked {B_nameDef} to say so face to face.

li.label: Keep {A_nameDef} to the night hours for a while
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} works the nights for the next few days and sleeps while the others are up, on the council's word.

li.label: Let it be
li.outcome: The council let it be again. {A_nameDef} stays, and the colony goes on as it was.
